proposition.claim:
For alphaU=betaU=a and alphaV=betaV=b, r has first-order term epsilon(a+b)/2.

a,b,epsilon>0; d>=1; isotropic centered Gaussian marginals N(0,a^-1 I), N(0,b^-1 I); nonnegative quadratic cost; all Theorem1.1 moments/smoothness and Corollary1.3 Hessian conditions hold; epsilon sqrt(kX kY)>2.
